name: lpa
description: Extract terms from a Limited Partnership Agreement (fund LPA). Mirrors Harvey's published LPA workflow (27 fields, 99.14% recall floor on matched corpus).

columns.description: Investment manager / management company, if separately named.
Fund structure (Delaware LP, Cayman LP, master-feeder, parallel fund, etc.).
Fund term length (e.g., '10 years plus 2 one-year extensions').
Investment / commitment period (e.g., '5 years from final closing').
Management fee rate and basis (e.g., '2% of committed capital', '1.5% of invested capital post investment period').
Management fee step-down mechanics after investment period ends.
Carried interest percentage (typically 20%) and any tiers.
Whether the agreement includes a GP clawback provision.
GP's own capital commitment to the fund.
Whether the agreement contains a key-person provision.
Named key persons if key_person_clause is true.
Whether LPs can remove the GP without cause (supermajority).
Whether the fund has an LP advisory committee.

notes: Waterfall type materially affects timing of carried interest — deal-by-deal (American) pays carry sooner than whole-fund (European).
Key-person clauses typically suspend the investment period until the GP proposes replacement key persons acceptable to the advisory committee.
Management fee step-downs are typically after the investment period (reducing base from committed to invested capital).
